videos.title: Kim Kardashian's Life Fell Apart Before It Opened Up
videos.description:
The first time a fire came for her house, Kim Kardashian packed every designer bag she owned. The fourth time, she left all of it behind.

In this episode, Kim Kardashian and Jay Shetty talk about what's left when you stop trying to make everyone happy, and why it took her until 40 to put herself first.

Kim opens up about the 20 minutes a day she keeps for herself, the nights when four kids all want the same mom at bedtime, and the case that pulled her into justice reform and changed how she sees people.

JAY'S DAILY WISDOM DELIVERED STRAIGHT TO YOUR INBOX
Join 900,000+ readers discovering how small daily shifts create big life change with my free newsletter. Subscribe https://news.jayshetty.me/subscribe
